name: CleanTech Services India Pvt Ltd
india_angle: CleanTech Services India Pvt Ltd is a leading provider of gas and chemical engineering solutions specifically for the semiconductor and high-tech manufacturing industries in India.
summary: CleanTech Services India Pvt Ltd specializes in providing gas and chemical engineering solutions, including gas delivery and chemical delivery systems, for the semiconductor industry. Their focus on ultra-high purity products and facility hook-up services ensures safety and operational excellence for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
